title: OUTLIER-ROBUST GROUP INFERENCE VIA GRADIENT SPACE CLUSTERING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy and unsupervised group identification quality (Adjusted Rand Index) on the COMPAS recidivism dataset across racial groups (African-American, Caucasian, Other races) and the CivilComments dataset based on mentions of Black and White identities.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy and group identification quality on the COMPAS recidivism dataset across male and female subgroups.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy and group identification quality on the CivilComments toxicity dataset based on the presence or absence of terms related to Christian, Muslim, and other religious identities.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy and group identification quality on the CivilComments toxicity dataset based on the presence or absence of LGBT identity terms.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy and group inference on the Waterbirds image dataset to measure the model's reliance on irrelevant background contexts (water vs. land) rather than the actual subject (bird type).
